name: How do I set a realistic budget for interior finish upgrades?

mainEntity.name: How do I set a realistic budget for interior finish upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Setting a realistic budget involves researching material costs, understanding labor expenses, and accounting for potential unforeseen issues. Obtain multiple quotes from reputable contractors to compare scope and pricing. Remember that material quality and customization will directly impact the total cost. Allocating a contingency fund, typically 10-15% of your total budget, is a practical tradeoff to cover unexpected expenses that might arise during the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Research material and labor costs, get multiple quotes, and include a contingency fund. Material quality directly impacts the overall budget.
